text:
Claude's landscaping review of Ange's sketch (20 Oct), to compare with your own thinking:
1. Herb bed on the south side: resolved, the herbs are shade tolerant.
2. Fruit trees at the east end sit under the gum cluster and the ironbark. Citrus want about 6 h of sun and dislike gum roots; the tree map from LiDAR will show whether that corner works.
3. Choose low-chill plum varieties for this mild coastal winter.
4. Septic: resolved, it is a pump-out system.
5. If the block is mapped bushfire-prone, the gum beside the house and an asset protection zone will need a decision.
